{{Quote|The only way to navigate the Maelstrom is using a Gree computer hidden at an Imperial fortress. We need that computer to free the Jedi prisoner.|[[Fleet Admiral/Legends|Fleet Admiral]] [[Oteg]]|<ref name="TOR:TJP">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|The Jedi Prisoner|the ''Telos''}}</ref>}}
A '''Gree computer''' was a [[Navigation computer/Legends|navigation computer]] located with in an [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] [[Taral V Imperial fortress|compound]] on [[Taral V]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] that provided the location of a hidden high security prison located in the [[Maelstrom Nebula/Legends|Maelstrom Nebula]]. [[Darth Malgus]] originally acquired the computer from the Gree during his expeditions to the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] and other distant parts of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].
